versions.notes: v1.3.3 (code 15): NEW raw ESC/POS voucher path (printVoucherRaw) — renders at exactly 576 dots (80mm) in-app and writes GS v 0 raster bands straight to the printer stream, so the DantSu library cannot scale or centre the receipt (root cause of the 384-dot / 48mm tiny prints). No paper-profile dependency, 12-line feed + auto-cut, toast reports 576 dots (80mm).
